resolved_conflicts.explanation: The March 1930 notice gives the steel tower as 97 feet (29.6 m). The 1942 Forest Service station description, quoted by the Central US Lookouts page, gives about 110 feet. The sources disagree and do not explain why; the record keeps the 1930 figure and the story reports both.

The 1930 notice describes a cooperative protection unit with the Texas Forest Service. The 1942 description and the county list place the station in Sam Houston National Forest. The record uses Sam Houston National Forest as the current listing.

notes_for_editor: Strong 1930 and 1942 descriptions, both quoted on one Central US page; the page reproduces the National Geodetic Survey station text, which we did not open separately. Height disagrees (97 ft in 1930, about 110 ft in 1942). No staffing or fire history found. No source says what remains at the site or whether the spot is open to the public, so access is omitted. The brief's record (agency, status, coordinates) checks out; no corrections proposed.
